paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Gittin 39b as finding Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak and asking him a question. Hyman reports the Bach’s reading Rabbah bar Shilat.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Gittin 39b makes Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak the one who found and questioned Rava bar She’ilta, reversing the encounter’s direction in Hyman’s supplied wording. Hyman’s account is translated as his account; the named digital witness is distinguished.

The whole Davidson Gittin 39b paragraph makes Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak find and question Rava bar She’ilta, as the existing note records. Hyman’s supplied reversed direction remains explicitly his account. The Bach’s Rabbah bar Shilat reading remains an attributed report, without fresh Bach collation or name harmonization.
